shapeSummary: Simplified round 3pi+ chassis: a 97 mm OD, 3 mm wall bumper skirt ring, 30 mm tall along Z, with an internal 3 mm base plate, a block representing the four-AAA battery holder, and two 7 mm wide wheel cylinders at the left and right sides. Total X is 100 mm, Y runs 0 to 97 mm, Z is 30 mm.
warnings: Dimensions are unverified; scale comes from the 32x7 mm wheel spec and the estimated bounds.
The wheel diameter is reduced from 32 mm to 30 mm so the part fits the 30 mm Z bound.
Bounds put the ring axis along Z, so Y is the 97 mm in-plane dimension and the part sits on Y=0 as instructed.
The battery holder is a plain block with no AAA cell bays, slots, or small holes.
The ball caster, motor pockets, motor clips, skirt cutouts and tabs, battery contacts, tire tread and wheel spokes are omitted.
Wheels are solid cylinders with no tires or axle holes, and they are fused to the skirt.
The kit is loose parts in the photo; this models one assembled approximation.
